svg.text: How production data is backed up on AWS and replicated to the on-premises DR site
KMS at rest · TLS in transit
1. Stop the replication window 2. Sync sequences 3. Start Odoo on DR
4. Point the ERP DNS name to the office IP 5. Users log in as usual
subscription enabled — changes stream from the WAL slot
RTO: manual failover per runbook — DNS switch + start services
